page_title: GET 1-1 OSA | Getafe v Osasuna 05/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Ooh that was close! Carles Perez (Getafe) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
90+4' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) commits a rough challenge and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick has been awarded to Getafe.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) is adjudged offside.
89' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
87' Looks like Borja Mayoral (Getafe) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
87' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) has tested the patience of referee Jose Sanchez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
85' Osasuna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
83' Substitution. Juan Berrocal Gonzalez makes his way off the pitch and Nabil Aberdin (Getafe) comes on as his replacement.
81' The resulting corner from Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) comes to nothing.

80' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the underside of the crossbar is, however, superbly saved by David Soria!
79' Vicente Moreno has decided to substitute Aimar Oroz and he is replaced by Moi Gomez (Osasuna).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ruben Pena (Osasuna) replaces Bryan Zaragoza.
78' That's unlucky! Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.
76' Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
76' A free kick from long distance is going to be taken by Getafe.
75' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) was quite harsh and Jose Sanchez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
74' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alberto Risco Alcantara (Getafe) replacing Alex Sola.
74' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Christantus Uche as he is replaced by Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe).
70' Good clearance! Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
66' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Getafe comes to nothing.
65' Christantus Uche (Getafe) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
63' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Getafe.
62' Referee Jose Sanchez signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Osasuna players have a reason to celebrate!
62' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was a handball in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Osasuna players aren’t happy.
60' 1 - 1 Goal! Bryan Zaragoza tees up Ante Budimir (Osasuna) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the left side of the goal. 1:1.
59' Christantus Uche (Getafe) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
59' Here is a change. Lucas Torro is going off and Vicente Moreno gives the last tactical orders to Jon Moncayola (Osasuna).
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ruben Garcia departs the field of play to be replaced by Raul Garcia (Osasuna).
58' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) commits a foul and Jose Sanchez immediately signals a free kick.
58' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
54' Omar Alderete (Getafe) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box. His effort heads for the left side of the goal, but Sergio Herrera denies him.
53' Getafe are awarded a free kick on the edge of the box.
53' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Sanchez had an easy-decision to make.
51' Alex Sola (Getafe) has a goal ruled out for offside!
50' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Getafe.
50' Alex Sola (Getafe) attempts to turn the rebound in from close range. Nevertheless, the goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save and stops the ball from hitting the net. Great goalkeeping.
50' Luis Milla (Getafe) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
49' Luis Milla (Getafe) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
46' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Borja Mayoral comes on the pitch for Bertug Yildirim (Getafe).
46' The game is over for Djene (Getafe). Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez comes on for the second half.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 12:2.
43' Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
42' Osasuna are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
42' Djene (Getafe) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
40' Osasuna win a direct free kick in a dangerous mid-range position.
39' Christantus Uche (Getafe) makes a rough challenge and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Luis Milla (Getafe) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
37' The ball is cleared after Ante Budimir (Osasuna) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
34' Jose Sanchez shows a yellow card to Lucas Torro (Osasuna) for his blatant foul.
34' David Soria is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Alejandro Catena (Osasuna). Easy save!
33' The linesman raises his flag. Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) is adjudged offside.
27' A lofted cross from Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
26' Getafe are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
26' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul.
21' 1 - 0 Goal! Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Alex Sola and easily beat the keeper with a header into the left side of the goal from close range. 1:0.
18' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 0:1.

15' Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
14' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna).
13' Osasuna will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
13' Jose Sanchez has a clear sight and sees a foul from Djene (Getafe).
10' Djene (Getafe) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Sergio Herrera, who smothers the ball.
8' Alex Sola receives a sweet cross inside the box from Djene (Getafe), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
5' Christantus Uche (Getafe) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar.
1' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
1' The first half has started.
Osasuna will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Jose Sanchez.
